Release Notes: VectorEngine v3.4.0

We are thrilled to announce VectorEngine v3.4.0, featuring significant performance enhancements in GPU-accelerated embedding search, distributed snapshot replication, and native OpenAI client compatibility.

Highlights

This release includes zero-copy memory mapping for vector segments, reducing initial index load times by up to 70%. We have also integrated SIMD AVX-512 distance calculation kernels for x86_64 architectures, boosting query throughput on multi-core servers.

Breaking changes: The deprecated v1 query API has been removed. All users must migrate to the v2 structured query endpoints.
